title: Confidence in U.S. Institutions Remains Near All-Time Low
discussion_signal: Gallup’s post frames low institutional confidence as broad but uneven: small business and the military remain relatively trusted while partisan gaps have widened across other institutions. The transcript and discussion add a question of whether legitimacy is institution-specific rather than a uniform collapse.
linked_research_question: How do public and professional discussions interpret historically low institutional confidence, partisan divergence, and the exceptions that retain legitimacy?
